name: scrutiny
title: Scrutiny
description: Scrutiny reads S.M.A.R.T. data from every disk and NVMe on this host, keeps the history and warns before a drive fails, with a clean dashboard. Runs privileged so it can see the drives; all-in-one image with its own InfluxDB.

policy_needs.reason: Scrutiny reads NVMe drive health with admin commands that need SYS_ADMIN
smartctl sends raw commands to the disks to read their S.M.A.R.T. data
Scrutiny's all-in-one image runs privileged so it can see every disk of the host
